description: Three segments that should sum close to total revenue — exercises the arithmetic reconciliation check, not just schema shape.
documentText:
Operator: Welcome to Delta Analytics' third quarter fiscal 2026 earnings call.

CFO: Thanks. Total revenue for Q3 2026 was $980 million, up 8.7% year-over-year. GAAP EPS was $2.01, non-GAAP EPS was $2.20. Operating margin was 19.5%.

By segment: our Data Platform segment generated $420 million, our Analytics Tools segment generated $380 million, and our Professional Services segment generated $160 million.

For Q4, we're guiding to revenue of $1.0 billion to $1.05 billion, consistent with our prior guidance.

During the quarter we completed the acquisition of a smaller analytics startup.

CEO: "Our analytics tools business had its strongest quarter yet."
